segments.text: Earlier in this series, we learned a few separation techniques, so let's learn another.
segments.zh: 在本系列前面，我们学习了几种分离技术，现在再来学一种。

segments.text: While some techniques separate the components of a mixture by virtue of differing solubilities,
segments.zh: 有些技术是根据溶解度不同、

segments.text: or boiling points, chromatography separates on the basis of differing polarities.
segments.zh: 或沸点不同来分离混合物的各组分，而色谱法则是根据极性的不同来分离。

segments.text: There are many different kinds of chromatography that work with different phases, but today
segments.zh: 色谱法有很多种，使用的相各不相同，但今天

segments.text: we will be looking at thin layer chromatography, or TLC.
segments.zh: 我们要看的是薄层色谱，也就是 TLC。

segments.text: This is a technique used to separate non-volatile liquids with different polarities by measuring
segments.zh: 这项技术用于分离极性不同的非挥发性液体，方法是测量

segments.text: their mobility in a certain solvent on a thin layer coated with adsorbent material, such
segments.zh: 它们在某种溶剂中、在涂有吸附材料的薄层上的迁移能力，吸附材料比如

segments.text: as silica gel or aluminum oxide.
segments.zh: 硅胶或氧化铝。

segments.text: We have already learned the details regarding this process in one of the lecture-based tutorials,
segments.zh: 我们已经在一期讲授型教程中学过这个过程的细节，

segments.text: so make sure to watch that video first for a conceptual understanding of this process,
segments.zh: 所以一定要先看那期视频，从概念上理解这个过程，

segments.text: as here we will focus more on how to physically perform the technique.
segments.zh: 因为这里我们将更多地关注如何实际操作这项技术。

segments.text: As we recall, all forms of chromatography utilize a mobile phase and a stationary phase.
segments.zh: 回想一下，所有形式的色谱都要用到流动相和固定相。

segments.text: The mobile phase moves through the stationary phase, picking up and separating the materials
segments.zh: 流动相在固定相中移动，带起并分离

segments.text: in the mixture.
segments.zh: 混合物中的物质。

segments.text: In TLC, the mobile phase is the solvent, while the stationary phase is the thin adsorbent
segments.zh: 在 TLC 中，流动相是溶剂，而固定相是薄薄的吸附

segments.text: layer, also called the TLC plate.
segments.zh: 层，也叫 TLC 板。

segments.text: Naturally, to perform thin layer chromatography, the main thing we need is the TLC plate.
segments.zh: 当然，要进行薄层色谱，我们最主要需要的就是 TLC 板。

segments.text: These can be different sizes depending on how many samples we're separating.
segments.zh: 根据要分离的样品数量，板的尺寸可以不同。

segments.text: Let's use this one today.
segments.zh: 今天我们就用这一块。

segments.text: We'll also need a solvent.
segments.zh: 我们还需要溶剂。

segments.text: The solvent systems selected will depend on the substances we're separating.
segments.zh: 所选的溶剂体系取决于我们要分离的物质。

segments.text: In this case, the solvent will be 95% ethyl acetate and 5% acetic acid, and this could
segments.zh: 在这里，溶剂是 95% 乙酸乙酯和 5% 乙酸，而且可以

segments.text: be modified to be more or less polar, depending on how well the components of a particular
segments.zh: 调整得极性更大或更小，这取决于某个特定

segments.text: mixture end up separating.
segments.zh: 混合物的各组分最终分离得如何。

segments.text: Then we need a glass container that we can use as our TLC chamber.
segments.zh: 然后我们需要一个玻璃容器，用作 TLC 展开缸。

segments.text: Of course we will also need our samples.
segments.zh: 当然，我们还需要样品。

segments.text: Today we're using two known sample standards, caffeine and aspirin, which we will label A
segments.zh: 今天我们使用两种已知的标准样品，咖啡因和阿司匹林，我们分别把它们标为 A

segments.text: and B respectively.
segments.zh: 和 B。

segments.text: We also will test a mixture of these compounds, as well as an unknown sample, to see if it
segments.zh: 我们还会测试这两种化合物的混合物，以及一个未知样品，看看它

segments.text: is A, B, or a mixture of the two.
segments.zh: 是 A、是 B，还是两者的混合物。

segments.text: This is one application of TLC, substance identification.
segments.zh: 这是 TLC 的一种应用：物质鉴定。

segments.text: Lastly, we will need some tweezers, a pencil and a ruler, and lastly some capillary tubes.
segments.zh: 最后，我们还需要一把镊子、一支铅笔和一把尺子，最后还要一些毛细管。

segments.text: These are what we will use to spot the plate with our samples.
segments.zh: 我们要用这些毛细管把样品点到板上。

segments.text: To start, let's draw a line at the bottom of the plate with pencil.
segments.zh: 首先，我们用铅笔在板的底部画一条线。

segments.text: This will have to be drawn around 1 cm from the bottom of the plate.
segments.zh: 这条线要画在距离板底部约 1 cm 的地方。

segments.text: Any lower and your sample will get washed away when you place it in the solvent.
segments.zh: 再低的话，把板放进溶剂时样品就会被冲掉。

segments.text: The silica is a very thin layer, so draw your line very gently to avoid scratching
segments.zh: 硅胶层非常薄，所以画线时要非常轻，以免

segments.text: it.
segments.zh: 把它刮坏。

segments.text: On the line, let's also put four dots for our four samples.
segments.zh: 在这条线上，我们再为四个样品点上四个点。

segments.text: Make sure that these are far apart from each other and evenly spaced.
segments.zh: 确保这些点彼此相距较远，并且间隔均匀。

segments.text: We can label our dots A, B, A plus B, and U for unknown.
segments.zh: 我们可以把这些点分别标为 A、B、A 加 B，以及代表未知样的 U。

segments.text: Now it's time to load the samples.
segments.zh: 现在该点样了。

segments.text: To do this, let's use a microcapillary tube like this one.
segments.zh: 为此，我们用一根像这样的微量毛细管。

segments.text: Dip the tube into the sample and wait for a bit.
segments.zh: 把毛细管浸入样品中，稍等一会儿。

segments.text: You'll see the liquid travel upwards due to capillary action.
segments.zh: 你会看到液体由于毛细作用向上移动。

segments.text: Then take the tube and spot the plate with the sample.
segments.zh: 然后拿起毛细管，把样品点到板上。

segments.text: On the corresponding dot, briefly tap the tip of the microcapillary tube.
segments.zh: 在对应的点上，用微量毛细管的尖端轻轻点一下。

segments.text: Do this about three times, but make sure you do it gently so that you don't scratch
segments.zh: 这样点三次左右，但一定要轻，以免刮伤

segments.text: the silica layer.
segments.zh: 硅胶层。

segments.text: You also want a small sample to maximize the resolution, do not let the sample spread out
segments.zh: 你还要让样品点小一些，以获得最佳分辨率，不要让样品扩散

segments.text: too much.
segments.zh: 得太开。

segments.text: To spot the other samples, make sure you use a different tube to prevent cross contamination.
segments.zh: 点其他样品时，一定要换一根毛细管，以防交叉污染。

segments.text: Also make sure that the spots do not bleed into one another, we want to make sure they
segments.zh: 还要确保各个样品点不会互相渗染，我们要确保它们

segments.text: are completely separated so that the results are unambiguous and easy to read.
segments.zh: 完全分开，这样结果才清楚明确、易于判读。

segments.text: Now let's prepare the TLC chamber, we'll need about 5 milliliters of the solvent.
segments.zh: 现在我们来准备 TLC 展开缸，需要大约 5 毫升溶剂。

segments.text: The solvent amount will vary depending on the size of the chamber, but for this small container,
segments.zh: 溶剂用量会因展开缸的大小而不同，但对于这个小容器，

segments.text: 5 milliliters is enough.
segments.zh: 5 毫升就够了。

segments.text: After adding the solvent, cap the chamber for a few minutes.
segments.zh: 加入溶剂后，把展开缸盖上几分钟。

segments.text: Using forceps or tweezers, let's grab our TLC plate and gently place it into the chamber
segments.zh: 用镊子夹起 TLC 板，轻轻放入展开缸中，

segments.text: like this.
segments.zh: 像这样。

segments.text: Again, it is very important that our solvent sits below the sample line on the paper,
segments.zh: 再强调一次，非常重要的是溶剂液面要低于板上的点样线，

segments.text: you don't want the solvent to touch your sample at this point, or it will wash into
segments.zh: 此时你不希望溶剂碰到样品，否则样品会被冲进

segments.text: solution and you can't run your plate.
segments.zh: 溶液里，你就没法展开这块板了。

segments.text: After introducing the plate, immediately close the cap and wait.
segments.zh: 放入板后，立即盖上盖子并等待。

segments.text: As you can see, the solvent will travel up the plate, and it will carry the samples
segments.zh: 如你所见，溶剂会沿着板向上移动，并带着样品

segments.text: with it.
segments.zh: 一起走。

segments.text: These samples will separate depending on their polarity.
segments.zh: 这些样品会根据它们的极性分离开。

segments.text: Generally, nonpolar substances move faster than polar substances, since the silicate material
segments.zh: 一般来说，非极性物质比极性物质移动得快，因为硅胶材料

segments.text: presents many hydroxyl groups which polar substances can interact with, and this stickiness
segments.zh: 带有许多羟基，极性物质可以与之相互作用，而这种由静电相互作用

segments.text: that results from electrostatic interactions causes polar substances to move along the
segments.zh: 产生的黏附性，使得极性物质在板上移动得

segments.text: plate more slowly than nonpolar substances, which are unable to make these interactions.
segments.zh: 比无法产生这些相互作用的非极性物质更慢。

segments.text: Be sure to monitor the chamber, since we don't want the solvent front to get all
segments.zh: 一定要注意观察展开缸，因为我们不希望溶剂前沿一直

segments.text: the way to the top of the plate.
segments.zh: 走到板的顶端。

segments.text: Remove the plate when the solvent front is just a bit away from the top, and quickly
segments.zh: 当溶剂前沿距离顶端还差一点时取出板，并迅速

segments.text: draw a line on the solvent front before it becomes invisible due to drying.
segments.zh: 在溶剂前沿处画一条线，以免它因干燥而看不见。

segments.text: Once you've done this, let the solvent dry on the entire plate before analysis.
segments.zh: 完成这一步后，让整块板上的溶剂干燥，然后再进行分析。

segments.text: When it comes to analysis, this can vary.
segments.zh: 至于分析方法，可能各不相同。

segments.text: Some chemicals will be colorful, and you'll be able to visibly see the separation on
segments.zh: 有些化学物质是有颜色的，你可以直接在板上看到

segments.text: the plate.
segments.zh: 分离情况。

segments.text: However, most compounds won't be visible.
segments.zh: 然而，大多数化合物是看不见的。

segments.text: An easy way to visualize the results is to put the plate under a UV lamp, as compounds
segments.zh: 一种简单的显色方法是把板放在紫外灯下，因为

segments.text: with systems of pi electrons become visible under UV light.
segments.zh: 具有 π 电子体系的化合物在紫外光下会变得可见。

segments.text: Using this setup we'll be able to see the samples, and circle them with pencil.
segments.zh: 用这套装置我们就能看到样品，并用铅笔把它们圈出来。

segments.text: If you do not have access to a safe setup like this one, be sure to use protective
segments.zh: 如果你没有像这样的安全装置，操作紫外灯时一定要佩戴防护

segments.text: eyewear when operating a UV lamp, as they can be damaging to your eyes.
segments.zh: 眼镜，因为紫外灯会伤害眼睛。

segments.text: Once we take the plate out of the UV setup, we now have circles that represent the final
segments.zh: 把板从紫外装置中取出后，我们就有了一些圆圈，代表样品最终

segments.text: locations of our samples.
segments.zh: 所在的位置。

segments.text: As you can see, B traveled farther than A. The spot representing A plus B does indeed
segments.zh: 如你所见，B 比 A 走得更远。代表 A 加 B 的点确实

segments.text: show data from both isolated samples, and it would appear that our unknown was B, aspirin.
segments.zh: 显示了两种单独样品的结果，而看起来我们的未知样是 B，也就是阿司匹林。

segments.text: From these results, we can also verify that A is more polar than B, which is why it didn't
segments.zh: 从这些结果中，我们还可以证实 A 的极性比 B 大，这就是为什么它

segments.text: travel as far up the plate.
segments.zh: 在板上没有走得那么远。

segments.text: We can even go further with our analysis by quantifying our results.
segments.zh: 我们甚至可以通过定量结果来进一步分析。

segments.text: This is done by measuring the retention fraction, or RF value for each sample.
segments.zh: 方法是测量每个样品的比移值，也就是 RF 值。

segments.text: This is calculated by taking the distance traveled by the sample, and dividing that
segments.zh: 它的计算方法是用样品移动的距离除以

segments.text: by the distance traveled by the solvent, so any RF value will be some fraction of one.
segments.zh: 溶剂移动的距离，所以任何 RF 值都是一个小于 1 的分数。

segments.text: We can do this by measuring the distance from the line at the bottom to the middle of the
segments.zh: 具体做法是用尺子测量从底部的线到样品点中心的

segments.text: spot, using a ruler, then measuring the distance from the bottom line to the solvent line,
segments.zh: 距离，然后测量从底线到溶剂前沿线的距离，

segments.text: and dividing the first by the second on a calculator.
segments.zh: 再用计算器把前者除以后者。

segments.text: RF values can then be compared to tabulated data in order to confirm their identities.
segments.zh: 然后可以把 RF 值与数据表中的数值进行比较，以确认它们的身份。

segments.text: In conclusion, TLC is a quick qualitative technique to confirm whether you have the desired
segments.zh: 总之，TLC 是一种快速的定性技术，可以确认你是否从反应中得到了目标

segments.text: product from a reaction.
segments.zh: 产物。

segments.text: We can also use it to monitor reactions by measuring the components at different stages
segments.zh: 我们还可以用它来监测反应，在不同阶段测定各组分，

segments.text: to ensure completion, depending on whether starting material remains in solution.
segments.zh: 根据溶液中是否还残留起始原料来确认反应是否完全。

segments.text: Since solvents separate components on the plate differently, we can also use TLC to screen
segments.zh: 由于不同溶剂在板上分离组分的效果不同，我们还可以用 TLC 来筛选

segments.text: for a good solvent system to be used in column chromatography, which is how we can
segments.zh: 适合柱色谱使用的溶剂体系，柱色谱就是我们利用相同性质

segments.text: physically separate an entire sample using the same properties.
segments.zh: 实际分离整个样品的方法。

segments.text: But for now, we have a better understanding of how to perform thin layer chromatography.
segments.zh: 不过现在，我们对如何进行薄层色谱已经有了更好的理解。
